_comment: REAL product catalog. Hoplinks use the affiliate redirect sl.defendsurviveprepare.com/<vendor-slug> so commissions track to you. 'liked_aspects' and keywords are written toward the practical/preparedness angle (not fear/conspiracy framing) for ad and email deliverability. Set active:false on any product you don't want the agent to use.

products.name: Hide Anything Anywhere
products.one_liner: A 227-page protocol for concealing food, supplies, and valuables in a normal home using search psychology.
liked_aspects: protects a stockpile you've already built
works in ordinary houses and apartments, no bunker or construction
practical room-by-room system with worksheets

products.name: Blackout Protocol Survival System
products.one_liner: A step-by-step system for keeping heat, water, food, and light during blackouts and grid failure.
liked_aspects: keeps a family warm and fed during power outages
uses low-cost tools you already own
clear step-by-step actions for the first 72 hours

products.name: Dark Reset: Survival Before the Silence
products.one_liner: An all-around preparedness guide covering food, water, medicine, and home security when systems fail.
liked_aspects: covers food, water, medicine, and defense in one plan
written for regular families, no special gear
practical steps you can complete in a weekend

products.name: The Doctor's Book of Survival Home Remedies

liked_aspects: written and vetted by a licensed doctor
remedies for the 20 most common health problems
uses herbs and items you can grow or find locally

products.name: Fight for Family Self-Defense

no weapons or physical strength required
master core moves in a few hours

works in limited space
